topic: Nature, Sources, and Characteristics of Light
key_concepts: Light is a form of energy that travels as a wave
Visible light is part of the electromagnetic spectrum
Light has a dual nature, behaving as both wave and particle
Isaac Newton proposed the particle theory of light
Christian Huygens formulated the wave theory of light
James Clerk Maxwell formulated the electromagnetic theory of light
Louis de Broglie proposed the dual nature of light
Luminous objects emit their own light while non-luminous objects do not
Natural light sources include the sun, fire, jellyfish, and lightning
Artificial light sources include flashlights and incandescent bulbs
Brightness or intensity of light decreases as distance from the source increases
Smooth shiny surfaces such as mirrors and aluminum foil reflect light well
